draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.51, the 260th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 1st of 1 at FB. He went 260th overall, close to where his grade ranked. No rankable athletic testing on record. College production: 320 rushing yards in 2021, 1st of 1 FBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 15 career games and 2 starts over 1 completed season. Career-best season: 0 AV in 2022. Strengths in 2022: receptions 5 (93rd percentile).
